podcast.title: First Release: Sam Cooke's Secular Material
podcast.body: Keen Records launched with Sam Cooke's secular recordings, including "You Send Me" and "Summertime," which Bumps Blackwell brought to the label after his departure from Specialty Records. "But Cooke and Blackwell were free to take you send me summertime and the rest, to a new label that wanted them for its first release. Keen."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Run Holden's Label in LA
podcast.body: After moving to Los Angeles, Run Holden signed with Keen Records, where he proceeded to record an entire album. "He moved to LA where he sang to Keene Records, where he recorded an entire album"
